country: Commonwealth of the Northern Mariana Islands

fields.climate: tropical marine; moderated by northeast trade winds, little seasonal temperature variation; dry season December to June, rainy season July to October
fields.terrain: the southern islands in this north-south trending archipelago are limestone, with fringing coral reefs; the northern islands are volcanic, with active volcanoes on several islands
fields.hazards: active volcanoes on Pagan and Agrihan; typhoons (especially August to November)
fields.farm: vegetables and melons, fruits and nuts; ornamental plants; livestock, poultry, eggs; fish and aquaculture products
fields.exports: scrap iron, refined petroleum, scrap copper, hydraulic engines, integrated circuits
fields.industries: tourism, banking, construction, fishing, handicrafts, other services
fields.languages: Philippine languages 32.8%, Chamorro (official) 24.1%, English (official) 17%, other Pacific island languages 10.1% (includes Carolinian (official), Chinese 6.8%, other Asian languages 7.3%, other…
fields.religions: Christian (Roman Catholic majority, although traditional beliefs and taboos may still be found)

system.text: a commonwealth in political union with and under the sovereignty of the US…

fields.legal: the laws of the US apply, except for customs and some aspects of taxation
